integrity: All claims proved analytically in the included text; exact example cross-checked by standalone script; no independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Positive fully connected dispersal, monotone nonlinear coefficients, strictly nonzero quadratic damping; deterministic finite-dimensional critical case only.
The universal coefficient depends on both recruitment and dispersal slopes; the proof is analytic, example check is finite.
Originality not independently validated; generic positive-map asymptotic literature can contain equivalent results.
title: Universal critical extinction profile in density-dependent metapopulations
